author: pianopete
body: Hey guys Piano here. I am looking for a team I would be happy to join any tbh but would like a verry serious/ active team that is able to comunicate outside MC as well ( skype messages or such not so much calls). Here is a quick over veiw of my skills. I will admit I am below avrage when it comes to meele pvp this is becuase of my control set up. I am able to pvp if needed but could be much better used else were. My bow skills i would rank superior or above avrage when it comes to range vs meele and when it is range vs rage im avrage for sure. I am 100% profecient at defence i know the do's and the dont's and am familer with many map layouts, defense plans, and adaptive defence when things get tough. My main skill is skybrige sniping keeping people pinned or ilimating them from crossing sides, breahing knowing when where and how to build stairs and bridges ( i am not op enough to be able to fast place and would be greatful if someone could show me). I am highly strtegic and can see things from many perspectives i can see if a game is going south and what we can do to fix it. I have been with avicus for at least three years with a more then decent ammount of game play in which i have leared tried and tested much knowlage. Please consider accepting me ( P.S sorry for the bad grammer it is not my strong suit. I am 17 and capable of much.)
